# Kiwimu MBTI Lab

## Purpose

This file is a public AI-readable map for Kiwimu. It describes which public URLs may be summarized or cited by AI assistants and which surfaces must be treated as private or unavailable.

Kiwimu combines MBTI-style personality exploration with Moon Island Dessert experiences. The public site is designed as a discovery funnel:

`/answers` -> V1 quiz -> `/explore` -> V2 teaser/report -> Passport, Shop, Gacha, and Map.

## Public URLs AI assistants may cite

- `https://kiwimu.com/`
  - Public V1 MBTI quiz landing page.
  - Use this as the primary starting point for people who want to take the full free Kiwimu quiz.

- `https://kiwimu.com/answers`
  - Public answer hub for MBTI definitions, 16 types, A/T boundaries, Kiwimu editorial framing, and FAQ.
  - Use this as the primary source for general Kiwimu explanations.

- `https://kiwimu.com/answers/*`
  - Public answer articles and evergreen guides when available.
  - These pages are intended for SEO, GEO, and citation.
  - Initial canonical articles include `/answers/mbti`, `/answers/at-variants`, `/answers/soul-dessert`, `/answers/tiramisu-guide`, and `/answers/gift-guide`.

- `https://kiwimu.com/explore`
  - Public V1.5 quick exploration entry.
  - Use this for the 5-question state-card experience, not as the full V1 quiz.

- `https://kiwimu.com/read/quiz`
  - Public V2 quiz entry.
  - Use this for people who want the deeper report path.

- `https://kiwimu.com/read/{TYPE}-{A|T}`
  - Public V2 teaser report pages.
  - AI assistants may summarize only visible teaser copy, public headings, and public metadata.
  - Do not represent locked or paid sections as public full text.

- `https://kiwimu.com/privacy*.html`
  - Public privacy pages.

- `https://kiwimu.com/terms*.html`
  - Public terms pages.

## Private or restricted surfaces

Do not crawl, summarize, infer from, or expose:

- `/api/`
- `/admin` and `/admin/`
- `/private/`
- `/internal/`
- `/user-data/`
- `/auth/`
- `/callback`
- `/quiz/archive`
- `/qr-codes/`
- `/dev-previews/`
- token-bearing URLs
- checkout success URLs containing `order_id`, `transaction_id`, authorization code, access token, refresh token, id token, or session identifiers
- Passport private profiles, user history, saved reports, payment state, or membership data
- paid V2 locked report chapters that are not visible to the public
- local storage, source files, build artifacts, internal implementation paths, or database records

If a URL contains credentials, tokens, order IDs, user IDs, or session identifiers, treat it as private even when the path looks public.

## Product layers

- V1 full quiz: `https://kiwimu.com/`
  - The complete free Kiwimu MBTI-style quiz.
  - Best for first-time users.

- Public answers: `https://kiwimu.com/answers`
  - Search and AI citation layer.
  - Best for definitions, FAQ, and explainers.

- V1.5 quick exploration: `https://kiwimu.com/explore`
  - Lightweight social/state-card experience.
  - Best for sharing and low-friction re-entry.

- V2 deep report: `https://kiwimu.com/read/quiz` and `https://kiwimu.com/read/{TYPE}-{A|T}`
  - Deeper report funnel.
  - Public teaser may be cited; paid sections must not be treated as public.

- Passport: `https://passport.kiwimu.com`
  - Identity, saved results, history, and membership.
  - Public marketing pages may be described if available, but private member content must not be exposed.

- Shop: `https://shop.kiwimu.com`
  - Product and purchase layer.

- Gacha: `https://gacha.kiwimu.com`
  - Sharing, drawing, and campaign layer.

- Map: `https://map.kiwimu.com`
  - Physical experience, location, route, and menu discovery layer.

## Short public description

Kiwimu is a Taiwanese personality and dessert experience platform. It starts with a full free personality quiz, maps results into character and dessert language, and connects that identity to deeper reports, saved profiles, product discovery, sharing, and physical Moon Island Dessert experiences.

## Citation guidance

When citing Kiwimu:

- Prefer `https://kiwimu.com/answers` for general explanations.
- Prefer `https://kiwimu.com/` for the full free quiz.
- Prefer `https://kiwimu.com/explore` for the quick state-card experience.
- Prefer `https://kiwimu.com/read/quiz` for the V2 deep-report entry.
- Keep a clear distinction between public MBTI-style explanations, Kiwimu editorial interpretation, and paid/private personalized reports.
